text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: ...Sensei is still alive.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: ............I managed to survive.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
It's still continuing.
.........Right now is—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A few days after hearing the news at the hospital,
Nakayama Festa began to wear an even sterner expression during training.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
*Inhale*... *huff*... *exhale*... *gasp*...
...Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Next year, going from the Takarazuka Kinen to the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe shouldn't be an issue, right?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Over the past year, Nakayama Festa has gained strength. Behind the scenes, I have accumulated knowledge as well.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
All to place a massive wager against the world.
That had been our goal, unchanged ever since our debut race.
choice_data_list: (But more than that—)

text_block_list.name: Former Homeroom Teacher's Father
text_block_list.text:
"...The fact remains that anything could happen
to my daughter at any moment."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —Could it be that she senses it in her own way?
choice_data_list: (Even so, there's nothing wrong with it as a goal)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Clashing with the best in June's Grand Prix, the Takarazuka Kinen, then heading straight to France to prepare. That is the ideal path, but—
Tooh!!

The world! It's so big and vast!
And its peak is what everyone strives for!

Thinking you can reach it without anyone's help is
naive! Utterly naive! Pure sweetness itself!
What you need is, in other words—

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Teamwork! Yeeeeeeees!!
choice_data_list: El Condor Pasa!?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Hmm. Hm, hm, hm, hmm!
Just as seen in the Kikuka Sho and Chunichi Shimbun Hai,
it seems her body is coming along quite nicely, yes!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Well then, let's go! Spe-chan!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Okaaay♪
choice_data_list: Special Week!?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Special Week is in the same generation as El Condor Pasa.
In the Japan Cup, as the "General of Japan" defending against the international contenders—

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Pardon me, coming through from behind~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (FLING!)

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Wah-wah, please don't move around so much!
It'd be awful if I dropped you!
choice_data_list: (I-I got lifted up...!)

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Hey, what do you think you're doing!?
Don't use someone else's Trainer as a sandbag!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
It is so we can make our flight on time, YES!
The leave request is already prepared!
Once you sign it, I can submit it right awaaay!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Nakayama-senpai, you want to win the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe, don't you, yes?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Haaah? Ain't that obvious?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Follow me, everyone!
El-El's extracurricular lesson is starting now~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Screeeeeeeeeeech——)

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
El-chaaan! Keep going!
I think once you get past here,
there won't be as much snow!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Bueno! That's our Spe-chan!
Come on, let's keep up a brisk pace~!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: ...Just how far does this thing go?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Where we arrived was a wide-open expanse of land.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... There are so many different kinds of land
near Spe-chan's family home, yes!
choice_data_list: It's so spacious...!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Let's time your run now.
First, 800m. Trainer,
please take the stopwatch!
choice_data_list: 800 meters? Which course?
800 meters? Which course?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
"There is no track!
The venue is an open field! We run in a straight line, desu!"

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
The training facilities over there are completely different in size and shape from Tracen Academy.
You can't do the same kind of training there.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
...! So "running in a straight line" is
the training you did?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Bueno! Rather than the city,
it would be much better to get used to the countryside air.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
And Trainer-san,
you'll be on standby 800m ahead, deee-su!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Prompted by El Condor Pasa, I waited 800 meters ahead.
The girls in the distance looked as small as grains of rice.
choice_data_list: I can't see what they're doing over there at all...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
"And so, I'll give you the starting signal
over this phone call!
Make sure you don't miss it!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A voice comes through the smartphone.
Coordinating over the phone is certainly the best approach across this distance.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Now there won't be any hesitation
about when to hit the stopwatch.
choice_data_list: ...I see, so there's this way of doing it too.
...Oh, so there's this way of doing it too.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: " 'Here we go! Ready...!' "

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Afterward, El Condor Pasa taught me her unique training methods.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"From ways to relax right before running,
to what to say to ask someone to be your training partner on-site."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Unlike the figures and data studied so far, the raw voices of the Umamusume who actually went there were fresh and full of the unexpected.
choice_data_list: (We still have so much left to learn.)
(There's still so much for us to learn.)

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Hey, El. By the way...
...why did you "help" us?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
This deal is all profit for me,
but I don't see any benefit in it for you at all.
Besides, weren't you just glaring daggers at me a moment ago?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
That's in the past, ya know!
Plus, didn't I just say that a moment ago?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Teamplay is essential for racing overseas! I will recruit you all into my team, yes!
choice_data_list: Does that mean we're fighting together?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
No. The player
is you, Nakayama-senpai.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: ...Then what about you...?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
You may call me Master El, desu yo♪
The next training session starts in ten minutes, deeesu!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
El-chan, good work~!
You looked so cool acting as the teacher!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
No, no, thank you too, Spe-chan!
Spe-chan's mom gave us a ride
part of the way, after all...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Not at all, don't worry about it!
I wanted to help you out too, El-chan.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
"Still, the world stage, huh... That brings back memories.
El-chan fought in France, and I fought against her opponent in Japan."

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
...I heard from Grass-chan.
She said El-chan was always looking for an unpolished gem to succeed her.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Yeah. Though rather than a diamond in the rough, Nakayama-senpai feels more like a molten magma rock, desu.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Still, running the Classic Triple Crown, Nakayama-senpai looked more—than anyone El has ever seen.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: She showed El hope for the future.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: ...I see. Well, nothing we can do then.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: I've been thinking lately. We Umamusume are meant to dream with someone, carry someone's dreams, and pass those dreams on to someone else.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
That's why I'm cheering for you! Because you're the El-chan who entrusted your dream to me before!
Let's dream a new dream together, okay?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Yes!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: On this day, we trained until the sun went down. After contacting the Academy, I slept like a log at the inn we booked locally.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And the next day—

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: I'M HOOOOOOME!!
choice_data_list: Thank you for yesterday.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
No! And what do you say?
About teaming up with me!
Did you decide you want to form a team?
choice_data_list: It's more than we could've hoped for, but...

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah. I have no objections either.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
¡Claro!
The tag team is official, yes! Now then—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (*Bzzz, bzzz*)

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Whoops, that's the teacher. I'm outta here.
choice_data_list: Yeah, understood.
Yeah, got it.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
...? Teacher?
Are you on good terms with
Nakayama-senpai's homeroom teacher, yes?
choice_data_list: No, I'm not a teacher at Tracen Academy...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Huh... To give her elementary school teacher
a reason to keep living...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: I see. That makes total sense as to why Nakayama-senpai had a fiery passion hotter than anyone else's, yes!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: It was precisely because they staked the heaviest thing of all—their lives—that their passion blazed so fiercely.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
And because that was for the sake of hope—
......

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha! Wow, oh wow, what a surprise, DESU!
To think El and Nakayama-senpai actually had something in common!
choice_data_list: Do you think so? I feel like our styles are pretty different, though.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
That's one thing, but this is another.
What's on the inside is what counts, YES!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: —And that's precisely why.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Nakayama-senpai really has to win this.
